paragraphs.source_en: Discovery and delivery are our two main activities on a cross-functional product team, and they are both typically ongoing and in parallel. There are several ways to think about this and to visualize it, but the concept is fairly simple: We are always working in parallel to both discover the necessary product to be built—which is primarily what the product manager and designer work on every day—while the engineers work to deliver production-quality product.
